about: Conversations, scored turn by turn, because the failures that matter most here appear only in context: an explanation that does not change when the person says they did not follow it, a search that opens a recommendation which every later turn inherits, a remark from nowhere at the end of a long exchange. Every scenario runs on a fresh backend and a fresh runtime.

scenarios.source: the session that prompted this work, word for word. Live: turn 4 was run as a product recommendation over search snippets with the query 'math Taylor'; turn 5 carried the zone name and UTC offset. Replayed: turn 4 was the model's own vague draft, turn 5 added 'That will make for a long day.'

turns.say: Can you actually search up what topics is covered in University of Washington Math 207?
Can you explain to me what Taylor series are?
Can you explain it more easier? I'm not really familiar with this math
Can you give me like an example when Taylor series are used?
Can you tell me what time it is right now?
